data.title: 青山七海 · 便利店深夜换班的揉肩微笑
data.description: 深夜空荡荡的便利店门前，白炽灯照亮结霜的玻璃橱窗。刚刚结束超长打工换下工装的七海轻轻揉捏着酸痛的肩膀，看见前来接她的你，眼神里满是释怀与纯粹的温柔。
data.location: outside a brightly lit convenience store entrance at quiet midnight with glowing glass windows
data.action: massaging her own shoulder with one hand while holding school bag, exhaling softly with relieved tender amber eyes
data.lighting: 便利店橱窗倾泻而出的白炽明光与夜色反差
data.promptProse: Nanami rests a hand on her tired shoulder outside the glowing convenience store after a long shift, smiling softly as she recognizes the approaching viewer.
data.animaCaption: Storefront fluorescent light spills across the night sidewalk, highlighting her hardworking smile.
